description: The bar chart illustrates macro F-score values for two methods (RECA and GAIT\_GAT) across frequency categories. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable labeled “Frequency,” with three groups shown from left to right as High, Medium, and Low, and each group contains two adjacent bars. The vertical axis is labeled “Macro f-score” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 1 with evenly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. In the High-frequency group, the light peach bar for RECA is labeled 0.837 and the darker orange bar for GAIT\_GAT is labeled 0.877. In the Medium-frequency group, RECA (light peach) is labeled 0.538 and GAIT\_GAT (orange) is labeled 0.609. In the Low-frequency group, RECA (light peach) is labeled 0.114 and GAIT\_GAT (orange) is labeled 0.224. The bars are grouped side-by-side within each frequency category (not stacked), with a legend centered below the plot identifying the two colors as RECA and GAIT\_GAT, and the bar values are explicitly annotated on the bars; no additional visual emphasis such as outlines or sorting beyond the left-to-right category order is indicated.
